Name: Eden, Son of Joah
Summary: Eden, son of Joah of the Gershonites, was one of the Levites who arose to cleanse the house of the LORD under Hezekiah.
KeyStory: Of the Gershonites, Joah the son of Zimmah and Eden the son of Joah arose to cleanse the house.
RelatedPeople: Joah, Son of Zimmah; King Hezekiah
LifeLesson: Sons followed fathers into the work of restoring worship.
